messages:
emma: Quick heads-up: landed a docs + SDK patch that adds a reproducibility opt-in for generation called --stable-outputs. SDK release: redwood-gen 1.4.0.
noah: what does --stable-outputs do?
emma: It forces deterministic temperature/seed handling and normalizes sampling so runs with same input+model+seed produce identical outputs across platforms. Useful for tests and audits.
noah: breaking?
emma: Not breaking for runtime behavior, but it changes default non-deterministic runs if teams opt in. Default remains non-deterministic. This is an opt-in flag and a minor release.
docs-bot: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1077 "SDK: reproducibility opt-in (--stable-outputs) + migration guide". Added examples for CI tests and for deterministic evals.
qa-bot: CI note: deterministic test suite using --stable-outputs passed on linux/gpu/cpu but flagged a platform-specific float-precision difference on macos-latest. Added note in docs about float precision caveat.
emma: snippet for CI to use stable outputs:```bash
# run deterministic smoke tests
redwood-gen generate --model gpt-xl --input test_prompts.jsonl --stable-outputs --seed 42 > stable_results.jsonl
# compare against golden set
python tools/compare_outputs.py stable_results.jsonl golden_stable.jsonl
```
noah: can customers rely on this for audits? any security concerns?
emma: security reviewed, no secrets change. The only caveat is that hardware and quantization can still cause tiny diffs; we recommend pinning model revision + runtime quantization profile. Docs list required pins.
security: Reviewed. Added guidance: pin model_revision and quant_profile, and include runtime metadata in audit logs.
docs-bot: Added a short "reproducibility checklist" to the PR: 1) pin model_revision 2) pin quant_profile 3) use --stable-outputs + seed 4) record runtime metadata.
noah: timeline?
emma: available immediately in 1.4.0. We'll monitor usage and expand platform testing. If teams need a compatibility shim for older SDKs, pin to 1.3.x.
noah: i'll notify eng-test and product-evals. emma: thanks! :rocket:
